The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available – 1 for Assistant Professor (Contract) in Commerce/Management and 2 for Assistant Professor (Contract) in Law.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CUSAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CUSAT to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CUSAT Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Assistant Professor (Contract) positions at CUSAT is 24th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor (Contract) at CUSAT?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Assistant Professor (Contract) posts announced by Cochin University of Science and Technology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for CUSAT Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree with 55% marks in the concerned subject, along with UGC NET/CSIR NET or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2018.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor (Contract) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 47,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for CUSAT Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹ 950/- for General/OBC candidates and ₹ 195/- for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the CUSAT Assistant Professor (Contract) positions must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q7. Where is CUSAT located?
faq.answer: Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) is located in Kochi, Kerala, with the pincode 682022.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor positions are on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Kerala apply?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Kerala. It's advisable to check the official notification for specific eligibility regarding domicile.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, labeled as 'Official Notification PDF'.
